verdict.rationale: Sunbiz's own pages list online filing of Articles of Organization for LLCs and Articles of Incorporation for profit and non-profit corporations. They also document online annual report filing paid by credit card, debit card or a prepaid E-File account, with immediate posting. The probe only concerns robots.txt crawl directives, not whether filing works, so it does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that online payment applies to formation filings themselves (payment is evidenced only for annual reports), and independent or hands-on confirmation of completing a formation filing end-to-end.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: Form a Limited Liability Company — Online Filing: Articles of Organization

Filed online with a credit card: Reports are processed and posted immediately.
Online Payment Options: Credit card (Visa, MasterCard, American Express or Discover).
